scope: Remove duplicated inner member and method-field order while preserving every existing serialized field and hash.
decisions: Four compiled nested rules describe named-type, owned-type, named-owned-type and trait-method records. New enum parts append after existing stable indexes0..24.
Only outer RuleFields includes its domain. Nested PartFields contributes rule.Parts only; nested diagnostic labels must not become serialized fields.

CSharp production struct/enum members, function inputs/parameters/associated pairs and trait method/parameter fields consume these rules. Existing declaration vectors8/8 and production cache5/5 remain exact.
SLG must iterate the same generated named-type/owned-type/trait-method plans. Source fact dispatch maps enum parts to a name/type/ownership value; no duplicated inner ordering.
Method parameter counts and parameter groups remain explicit part handlers. Missing or unsupported parts must error; no skipped unknown parts or silent defaults.
